title: Water Damage Mitigation Drying Estimate and Deposit Calculation Sheet
content:
## Calculation sheet — Water Damage Mitigation drying deposit

**Clause.** The drying estimate prices the drying equipment the job will run: air movers at the tier's air mover daily rate, dehumidifiers at a dehumidifier daily rate and air scrubbers at the tier's air scrubber daily rate, for a number of drying days. The air movers are one air mover for every 60 square feet of the affected floor area, rounded up. The dehumidifiers are one for every 500 square feet of the affected floor area, rounded up, and the dehumidifier daily rate is the tier's LGR dehumidifier daily rate. The drying days are the tier's billable drying day cap. The air scrubbers are one where the tier requires an air scrubber and none otherwise. The daily equipment cost is the air movers times the air mover daily rate, plus the dehumidifiers times the dehumidifier daily rate, plus the air scrubbers times the air scrubber daily rate; the drying estimate is the daily equipment cost times the drying days, multiplied by every estimate multiplier that applies to the job. The drying deposit is 60 percent of the drying estimate, rounded to the cent, half up, but never less than the tier's self-pay deposit. The amount collected is the drying deposit plus every charge posted to the job, less every customer payment posted to the job and plus any refund issued from those payments, rounded to the cent, half up; when that amount is zero or less nothing is collected.

## Sheet lines
| Line | Source |
|---|---|
| Affected floor area | the area mapped on the job record |
| Air movers | one per 60 square feet of that area, rounded up |
| Dehumidifiers | one per 500 square feet of that area, rounded up |
| Air scrubbers | one if the tier requires an air scrubber, otherwise none |
| Daily rates | the tier's air mover, LGR dehumidifier and air scrubber daily rates |
| Drying days | the tier's billable drying day cap |
| Charges posted, customer payments posted, refunds issued | the job's own ledger |

## Worked figure (hypothetical job and rates)
Assumed for illustration: affected floor area 650 square feet; air mover $30.00, dehumidifier $100.00 and air scrubber $80.00 per day; an air scrubber required; a cap of 5 days; a self-pay deposit floor of $1200.00; no estimate multiplier applying; charges posted $420.00, customer payments posted $300.00, no refunds.
1. Air movers: 650 divided by 60 is 10.83, rounded up to 11. Dehumidifiers: 650 divided by 500 is 1.3, rounded up to 2. Air scrubbers: 1.
2. Daily equipment cost: 11 times $30.00, plus 2 times $100.00, plus 1 times $80.00, that is $610.00.
3. Drying estimate: $610.00 times 5 days, that is $3050.00.
4. Drying deposit: 60 percent of $3050.00 is $1830.00, which is not less than the $1200.00 floor.
5. Amount collected: $1830.00 plus $420.00, less $300.00, that is $1950.00.

Had the customer payments posted already reached $2250.00 or more, the amount collected would be zero or less and nothing would be collected.
